name: HPC Runner
tagline: Upload a zip of code and data and it runs on an HPC cluster, guessing the entry point and resources for you.
problem: Researchers and students are blocked by schedulers, scripts and cluster setup.
solution: A web interface detects the program's entry point, estimates compute needs, submits to a Slurm cluster and streams progress and errors, with an MCP interface for agents.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a project, watch it run, see a failing job explained.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Second Overall Software Hack” among 176 submissions.
Answers a sponsor's HPC-for-non-experts brief and placed overall.

lessons: Hide the expert step entirely: guess the configuration for the user.
